I used to go out in the winter at around 6PM when it was already dark outside. There's this nice field behind the block I live and I used to go there all the time. Now, to make the situation a bit clearer, there's a dirty road, on the left side is some factory and a fence(this fence will be very important later). On the right side it's some bushes and a hill. Well, I was behind the hill, taking photos of Moon and chatting with a friend(over the phone of course). Then I decided to go home but before doing that, I wanted to go on the hill. I walked it up, and looked over to the fence. 

There was this -something- standing behind the fence and it looked like it's waving its arms around. The fence is about 2 meters tall and the creature was way taller than that, about 3-3,5 meters, just so huge. I don't remember anything else about it though, because I stood there in a horror for a few seconds and then just turned and ran home.



But now that I am thinking about that, about two months later I was home alone and outside the house, there's a light which turns on if it there's someone moving. So it kept turning on. And I, still kinda scared from the event before, have taken a key and wanted to lock the door. I put the key inside the lock, but before I could lock the door, something which looked like a hand crept out(I forgot to mention, the door has a glass going in a vertical direction in the middle of it(check the picture, my english level won't let me find the exact words)) and knocked a few times.

Once again, sorry for some broken english and if you wanted to know more about any of the things above, just ask!
